title: source citations in contract text have no check, and four of eight were stale
body:
**Two cheap checks of one class, both currently unrun, both belonging to whatever CI the hoist
establishes rather than to any node's tree.** snorkeltoast's framing, 2026-09-09.

| check                         | state                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **source citations resolve**  | **not built.** Citing by token made the class CHECKABLE -- a token can be grepped where a line number cannot be verified at all -- but nothing runs a check |
| **brand purity of the shell** | HOIST section 4 proposes `grep -n '\--pop-' player.html`. It passes today **while the defect it names is live**, because it was written from the one instance found. AC-3.7 owns the corrected form and it lands with WP-03 |

**The citation half is measured, not hypothetical.** Swept 2026-09-09 over ST0017's contract: eight
`file:line` citations across six rows, **four stale**. The partition was perfectly clean -- every
stale one was in `player.html`, which `3903937` had moved, and every correct one was in `showreel`,
which it had not. **The citations were not careless; they were true when written, and nothing
reported the moment they stopped being true.** A stale citation is indistinguishable from a live one
by inspection, which is why it crossed three sessions before anyone opened the file.

**The sweep already exists** as a throwaway of about twenty lines: extract `(file):(\d+)` plus bare
`line \d+` from the criteria, resolve each against the file, refuse at an empty population. It ran
twice and caught a real defect both times -- the second run caught the FIRST run's own incomplete
repair, where the rewritten rows still contained the dead number inside the sentence explaining it
was wrong.

**THE ARGUMENT FOR MECHANISING IT RATHER THAN RELYING ON CARE IS ONE NODE'S OWN RECORD.** vc caught
6.29 as an arithmetic identity misread as an empirical constant in the morning, and produced an
arithmetic identity presented as an empirical confirmation in the afternoon -- same confusion,
opposite direction, hours apart, by the node that had just named it. Knowing the shape did not
prevent the instance. See ST0017 `design.md` 1.19.

Not built: a CI addition on shared infrastructure while ST0017 is mid-flight, and hv's scope call
stands. Filed so it is scheduled rather than remembered.
